title: pm-dispatch skills: drop the "review seat must be another account" lines (lanes/review.md:19, area-lease.md:13), per the maintainer
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. The maintainer, 2026-11-15T15:59Z (project chat): 「定复审席必须由另一个账号来坐 没有这个规定」, then 「是skills的问题吗？应该立卡修改」.

## The text that misstates it (origin/main)

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md:19`: 「⛔ 不复核本账号派发或实现 PR,`area-lease.md` 例外;记录恒带 `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` 对。」
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md:13`: 「复核席约每 3 活跃区一席,由他账号坐(`lanes/review.md`);同账号须维护者在该复核线程亲字。」

Effect today: review-b (same account as the dispatching seat) stopped taking claims on a literal reading, stalling S2/S4 PRs.

## Fix

Rewrite both lines: a review thread may sit on any account, the dispatching seat's included. Independence is the record's `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` session pair (reviewer session ≠ implementing session), and contract-review.md's ④ rule (run by an agent other than the drafter) is unchanged. Line counts unchanged.

Built in PR #33938 (branch `claude/area-W0-33907`, Tier S), which is already rewriting area-lease.md.
